_doc: ⚑ THE RESTART CARD — on Daniel's 1997 monitor, lit inside the Close (Sérgio, 2026-09-12: 'We need a way to enter the restart as you option… think of a better idea' → ruled: Daniel's monitor in the Close). Drawn in ERA1's own palette and type because it is that machine speaking, thirty years on, and it is the frame's voice — functional, undecorated. Text is Claude's under the 2026-08-17 norm (docs/reinterp/ERA4_DRAFTS_2026-09-12.md §1); Sérgio's edit wins. `kept` is the one sentence that is TRUE of the piece and FALSE of every apparatus in it — CLAUDE.md's no-storage invariant, said out loud once. No thanks-for-playing, no credits: credits stay in the game menu.
title: Restart as you are.
kept: Nothing you did here was kept by anyone but you.
choose: Go back to a room, or start the machine again.
witness: the machine offered its restart; nothing was kept
makers: Made at the University of Bergen (SurvivingSOGICE) with Claude. Credits & sources: the menu.
_docMakers: ⚑ S143: the one-line disclosure on the last screen — frame voice, small, under the buttons. The long form is the MAKERS paragraph in the Credits view (docs/reinterp/ATTRIBUTIONS.md).
